Frequently asked questions

Answers to Help You Start with Confidence

Learn what to expect from consultations, sessions, insurance, scheduling, and telehealth.

What is your therapeutic approach?

I use an evidence-based, integrative body-mind approach tailored to your unique needs rather than a one-size-fits-all model. By weaving together body knowledge, present-moment awareness, thoughts, and psychoeducation, I help you understand your body's signals and build internal safety.

My goal is to support you in moving out of distress and into a grounded, resilient way of living.

Can I use my insurance benefits?

Yes. I am in-network with multiple plans under Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Optum, and others. If you use out-of-network benefits, I can provide a monthly superbill for you to submit for potential reimbursement.

Verify your insurance coverage (opens in a new tab) before your first session.

What happens during the 30-minute consultation?

We talk briefly about what brings you to counseling and how we can work together. I will answer questions about my approach, review basic administrative details, and discuss next steps if we decide to move forward.

What is your cancellation or missed-session policy?

Twenty-four hours' notice is required to cancel an appointment to avoid paying the full session fee. If you need to reschedule, I will work with you to find another time within the same week based on availability.

If a mutual time is unavailable and 24 hours' notice was not provided, the full session fee will apply. Sudden illnesses and emergencies are considered individually.

What happens during the first session?

The first session or two allows me to get a clear picture of who you are and how I can best support you. We will review the initial paperwork and questionnaires you completed, gather background on your history and relationships, and begin getting to know each other at a comfortable pace.

Do you offer in-person counseling, telehealth, or both?

In person: Available one day a week at my office in North Scottsdale, Arizona.

Telehealth: Available for clients located anywhere in Arizona or New Mexico through a secure, HIPAA-compliant video platform.

How long are sessions?

Sessions are scheduled for a full 60 minutes. I take pride in starting on time and respecting your day. If we are in the middle of particularly intense or meaningful work, I build in a small cushion so we can wrap up safely without feeling abruptly cut off by the clock.

How often will we meet?

I generally recommend starting with weekly sessions for the first four to six weeks to build a strong working connection and establish momentum. From there, we can adjust session frequency based on your progress, goals, and schedule.

Still have a question? A consultation is a good place to start.

Request a consultation

For medical emergencies, contact your healthcare provider or call 911. For a mental health crisis, call or text 988.
